text:
support_maya: Customer acme-inc (org-8421) reporting sudden 429s on Dedicated pool after plan migration at 08:03 UTC. They say requests that used to succeed now get 429 within 5-10s of starting. No recent model changes. Can we triage?

oncall_cheng: Is this per-tenant 429 or pool-wide? Any examples of request IDs? Also paste tenant id & plan.

support_maya: Tenant org-8421, plan 'reserved-2x'. Example resp headers:
`x-rw-status: 429`
`x-rw-rate-key: org-8421` 
`x-rw-retry-after: 30` 

prod_sre_jess: grabbing logs for org-8421 from dedicated-pool-4

prod_sre_jess: log snippet:
```
2025-04-10T08:02:59Z INFO request_id=aa1 org=org-8421 tokens=120 status=200
2025-04-10T08:03:05Z INFO request_id=aa2 org=org-8421 tokens=240 status=429 rate_key=org-8421 quota_remaining=0
2025-04-10T08:03:10Z INFO request_id=aa3 org=org-8421 tokens=64 status=429
```

oncall_cheng: quota_remaining=0 — looks like per-tenant ceiling dropped to 0 during warmup. Any recent plan-sync jobs deployed?

support_maya: We ran a plan translation job yesterday to migrate minute->second denom for some customers. Could be related.

eng_oliver: Checking mapping: plan conversion mistakenly wrote `denom: "hour"` for warmup window for some orgs due to fallback. That sets warmup window to 3600x expected. In code we interpret warmup_tokens_per_unit / unit_seconds -> effective rate cap. So if unit is 'hour' instead of 'second', cap becomes tiny.

eng_oliver: repro steps:
1) set org plan to reserved-2x with warmup_unit='hour'
2) issue steady small requests -> tokens consumed accumulate and quota_remaining hits 0 quickly -> 429

quick patch: interpret legacy denom values and normalize units on plan-sync; also add validation to plan importer.

support_maya: Customer on thin SLO; need hotfix and temporary mitigation. Can we bump ceiling for org-8421 asap?

eng_oliver: I can bump ceiling to +10x for org-8421 and push a hotfix canary to convert denom normalization.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started: canary-2025-04-10-09:05 -> eng-dedicated/plan-sync-normalize

prod_sre_jess: bumped ceiling for org-8421 at 08:45 UTC. Monitoring.

prod_sre_jess: After bump, 429s dropped to near-zero, latency back to normal for 30m. Will keep watch and roll forward patch to prod if good.

support_maya: Customer updated & grateful. I'll schedule postmortem and include repro steps + plan migration checklist.

eng_oliver: Follow-ups: add alert for sudden drop in per-tenant cap, validate denom on import, add e2e test for plan migrations. 

prod_sre_jess: Filing incident ticket and action items.

support_maya: Thanks all :thumbsup:
